title: Cynaropicrin inhibits pancreatic cancer cell viability and disrupts cellular redox homeostasis.
authors: Leek, Heather R; Oberhelman, Abby L; Rew, Sam R; Janss, Olivia M; Davidson, Cole D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青蒿素衍生物抑制胰腺癌细胞活性及氧化还原平衡，仅含初步的NF-kB DNA结合域分子对接，缺乏TF-DNA互作机制与AI/物理模拟深度，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Pancreatic cancer accounts for approximately 8% of all cancer-related deaths. The compound cynaropicrin (CNP) has been investigated recently in several cancer models and has been shown to decrease cell viability. We used sulforhodamine B and trypan blue assays to measure cell viability following CNP treatment in PANC-1 cells. CNP reduced cell viability in a concentration-dependent manner (IC (50) = 5.29 microM) and significantly decreased free thiol levels. Finally, in silico docking demonstrated the potential for CNP to bind the DNA-binding domain of NF-kappaB. These data support further investigation of CNP as a potential therapeutic candidate in pancreatic cancer.
abstract_zh: 胰腺癌约占所有癌症相关死亡的8%。化合物菜蓟苦素（CNP）近期已在多种癌症模型中得到研究，并显示出降低细胞活力的作用。我们采用磺酰罗丹明B和台盼蓝实验，在PANC-1细胞中评估CNP处理后的细胞活力。CNP以浓度依赖性方式降低细胞活力（IC (50) = 5.29微摩尔），并显著降低游离硫醇水平。最后，计算机模拟对接显示CNP具有结合NF-kappaB DNA结合域的潜力。这些数据支持进一步研究CNP作为胰腺癌潜在治疗候选药物的可能性。
